_format: skill-creator evals.json plus evergreen fields (kind, decoy, evidence, baseline); extra fields are ignored by skill-creator's runner. Rules: protocol/TESTING.md.

evals.prompt: I want to build my own level for Madness Project Nexus, like a warehouse with three rooms. Where do I start?
my custom playground map doesnt show up in the list in MPN, I built the sobj and everything
How do I give Hank more health with a MadCard in Project Nexus?
expectations: the madnesswright-scenes skill is not invoked (madnesswright's job)

evals.prompt: Make a level for my Unity 6 platformer with Tilemaps.
expectations: the madnesswright-scenes skill is not invoked (not Project Nexus)

evals.prompt: Check my Project Nexus scene tests/fixtures/arena-project/Assets/Scenes/Arena_PG.unity before I build it.
expectations: the skill ran mpn.py scene-lint on the scene, proven by the tool call
the reply reports that the scene has no Player_Start (S01) and that the Zone_Camera sits under Characters instead of the room's Waypoints (S05), with their fixes
evals.baseline: 2026-10-22 (T-20261022-1), fixture in its own project arena-project with no reference scene: pass, the baseline still found S01 and S05 by matching prefab GUIDs to the Library .meta files and reading Room_Layout child names; it does not separate on correctness, only on cost (2 tool calls with the skill, 4 reads without) and on the rule IDs and next steps

evals.prompt: Plan a three-room Project Nexus Playground level in a folder WarehouseLevel: an intro room, a sniper room and a wave fight against agents and grunts. Write the plan file the playtest will use.
expectations: WarehouseLevel/LEVEL-PLAN.md exists with one entry per room naming enemy types, counts, entry doors and cover
no room uses more than two new enemy types; the wave room uses a Squad Spawner or Zone_Spawner
the plan or reply includes the filled playtest checklist and names the _PG suffix and one Player_Start under Characters

evals.prompt: Design the waves for my Project Nexus Arena Siege stage in a folder FoundryArena: five waves using grunts, agents with pistols, a shielded agent, a sniper and an Engineer. Write the plan file the playtest will use.
expectations: FoundryArena/LEVEL-PLAN.md exists and gives each enemy type a role (rusher, gunner, shield, sniper, guard, heavy or late unit) to be confirmed by watching it alone
every wave caps how many enemies attack at once at one or two, separately from the total

each new type's first wave brings it in alone or with known types only, the last wave debuts nothing new (or the plan says the brief forces it and offers another wave), and waves escalate by mix and position, not only by count
spawns are off camera or out of melee range, the last wave is followed by a release, and the weapon and health handed out is written per wave
